headline: Hint, a new AI startup co-founded by Martha Stewart, offers an AI assistant for homeowners
context: AI home management startup Hint, co-founded by Martha Stewart, wants to become an “AI for your home,” combining property records, maintenance schedules, home documents, and an AI assistant into a single app.
